notes: UX-01 Batch 4B - visual QA on Batch 4A found the personal nav ('Bảng điểm hiện tại'/'Hồ sơ đánh giá') still read as a bolted-on component next to the manager sidebar: different item size, border/shadow, icon box, spacing, active state. Root cause: Batch 4A built .phfck-personal-nav as a separate light-card CSS system instead of reusing the manager sidebar's actual renderer/CSS - and that CSS is a dark-green-gradient, sticky, full-height .phfck-sidebar/.phfck-nav (shared app-wide sidebar language), not a light card, which Batch 4A never matched. Fixed by extracting two shared renderers - checklistNavItemHtml(opts) (icon+title+badge+description button, byte-identical to the old item()/violationItem() output when called with manager-shaped args and no ariaCurrent) and checklistSidebarShellHtml(opts) (the <aside class='phfck-sidebar ...'><head><nav>...</nav><foot></aside> shell) - and refactoring BOTH managerSidebarHtml() and personalChecklistTabsHtml() to call them. Manager now differs from personal only in the CONFIG it passes (section vs path attribute, head/admin-link/foot content); personal opts into aria-current='page' via a flag manager never sets, so manager's DOM literally cannot change. .phfck-personal-layout's grid CSS was merged into the SAME declaration block as .phfck-manager-layout (one rule, two selectors) instead of being a second clone with identical values; all of Batch 4A's separate .phfck-personal-nav/-list/-icon CSS is deleted, zero dead rules left. Personal sidebar reuses .phfck-sidebar's dark background/sticky/border-radius/padding wholesale; the only personal-specific CSS left is a mobile-only override (.phfck-personal-sidebar .phfck-nav{flex-direction:row}) turning the 2 items into a horizontal row where manager sidebar has no mobile precedent to reuse (it's JS-hidden on mobile). No route/state/loader/backend/permission logic touched. Regression: scripts/test-checklist-assessment-profile-ui.js gained an executable byte-equivalence proof (Node vm sandbox runs the extracted renderer functions against representative manager AND personal inputs and asserts exact string equality against the pre-refactor templates) plus CSS-isolation checks proving no new bare .phfck-nav/.phfck-people-scope-chips redefinition - 103 checks total. Full checklist suite (15 scripts, including 33/33 Batch1/2 backend) re-run clean.
